summary: __stdcall stream-value reader with conditional scaling. Copies input a3 into local v3, then calls FileWriteWithBackendDispatch to populate a 4-byte header at v3. Based on header bits it either stores the incoming float a2 directly at v3+4 or scales a single byte read from the stream by the global double dbl_5ACD28 (0.0001670000056037679) added to a2 before storing at v3+4. Finally it reads a payload of (header >> 8) & 0x3FF bytes into v3+8 and returns 0. Despite the callee name, the surrounding reads indicate backend read/dispatch behavior.

local_names.a2: float value stored or added as base before scaled storage
local_names.a3: pointer to stream buffer; initial 4-byte header read into it
local_names.v3: copy of a3 holding the buffer pointer

operations.description: Copy input parameter a3 into local v3 (esi).
Call FileWriteWithBackendDispatch(a3, 4); the 4-byte header later tested at v3 is populated by this call.
Branch on header bits: when (*(DWORD*)v3 & 0xE0000000) != 0x20000000 or (*(DWORD*)v3 & 0xFC0000) != 0, store a2 raw; otherwise treat the value as a scaled-byte form.
In the non-scaled branch, store the float a2 directly into *(float*)(v3 + 4).
In the scaled branch, call FileWriteWithBackendDispatch(&a3, 1) to read a single byte into a3.
Compute the scaled value: (double)(unsigned __int8)a3 * dbl_5ACD28 + a2, where dbl_5ACD28 is the global double 0.0001670000056037679.
Call FileWriteWithBackendDispatch(v3 + 8, (*(_DWORD*)v3 >> 8) & 0x3FF) to read a payload of (header >> 8) & 0x3FF bytes into v3 + 8.
